A page has a pulse

Watch the final turquoise rules. Both panes contain exactly the same lines; the right pane should finish about 12 px lower.

01 A quiet opening establishes the measure.
Its second line fixes the paragraph depth.
The rule exposes its authored bottom edge.

02 Each paragraph keeps the same words.
No line is rebroken by the refinement.
Only the existing gap below it can grow.

03 Spare column depth is measured last.
The paginator already chose every line.
A bounded correction follows that choice.

04 Every individual adjustment is tiny.
This page has few enough gaps to see it.
Their accumulated movement is clearer.

05 Text shaping remains entirely fixed.
Glyph positions within a line do not move.
The rule stays attached to its paragraph.

06 The two columns begin identically.
Their rules then separate little by little.
The difference reaches its cap at the foot.

07 Structural boundaries remain rigid.
Tables and keeps are never stretched.
This ordinary prose gap is safe to adjust.

08 Compare this final rule across panes.
The right rule should be visibly lower.
The following material starts a new page.

09 Sparse pages are never stretched wildly.

10 The next reader page starts normally.

11 A second sequence makes navigation useful.

12 Resize vertically to vary available slack.

13 Resize horizontally to change the measure.

14 The right pane applies the optional pass.

15 The left pane is the untouched reference.

16 Compare the final rules near the foot.

17 Natural gaps remain recognizable.

18 Their rhythm is merely refined.

19 Later content continues on another page.

20 Page Up and Page Down move both panes.

21 Small corrections avoid conspicuous holes.

22 Existing semantic keeps still take priority.

23 The source geometry remains authoritative.

24 Pagination owns only its projection.

25 This is deliberately an opt-in treatment.

26 The final document column stays ragged.
